# OnToGraPh

> OnToGraPh is a standalone semantic governance framework by Fabrizio Degni. It connects dictionaries, taxonomies, controls and application observations to a frozen release. It runs locally with Python and SQLite.

## Project and evidence

- [English overview](https://openontograph.org/) and [简体中文](https://openontograph.org/zh/).
- [Governance hub](https://openontograph.org/#ecosystem): PolicyWatcher supplies source evidence. PALO Framework defines review gates. The standalone engine can also use an adopter’s own sources and vocabulary.
- [Interactive pilot](https://openontograph.org/pilot/) and [中文试点](https://openontograph.org/pilot/zh/). In the recorded pilot, PolicyWatcher was read-only and PALO was local. The case remained pending human review.
- [Pilot evidence](https://openontograph.org/pilot/evidence.json): measured outcomes, release digest and receiving case.
- [Narrated film and transcript](https://openontograph.org/film/) and [中文影片与文字稿](https://openontograph.org/film/zh/).
- [Aurora 21](https://openontograph.org/demo/) and [中文模拟案例](https://openontograph.org/demo/zh/): a separate synthetic CRM/PMS example.
- [Source code](https://github.com/sev7enITA/OntoGraph) and [reproduction instructions](https://github.com/sev7enITA/OntoGraph/tree/main/examples/hub_pilot).
- [PolicyWatcher](https://policywatcher.online/) and [PALO Framework](https://paloframework.org/PALO_PlatformMap.html).

## Adoption and architecture

- [Practical guide](https://openontograph.org/guide/) and [简体中文指南](https://openontograph.org/guide/zh-Hans.html). Import a personal library model, reconcile WBS fields across departments, and publish a read-only glossary for a Copilot agent.
- [Architecture puzzle](https://openontograph.org/architecture/) and [架构拼图](https://openontograph.org/architecture/?lang=zh-Hans). Explore the effect of missing evidence and assumed adapters in two synthetic cases.
- [Weighted decision impact](https://openontograph.org/weights/) and [加权关系](https://openontograph.org/weights/zh/). Five synthetic evidence scenarios compare assessed, incomplete and disputed paths to Finance processes and a mandatory release assessment requirement.
